argv.description: Executable and arguments; no shell parsing or variable expansion.

cwd.description: Existing working directory, relative to this config file if not absolute.

timeout.description: Positive finite wall-time limit in seconds.

source_revision.description: Caller-provided revision identity; the recorder does not authenticate it.

evidence_scope.description: Precisely what this command can establish.

environment_inventory.description: Optional existing inventory file; record its byte length and SHA-256, not the environment.

metadata.description: Caller-provided descriptive metadata; never interpreted as execution instructions.

markers.description: Literal UTF-8 substrings. These observations do not imply semantic or cryptographic verification.
